title: Aligned reach: the role-window weight beside every raw money figure
body:
## Summary
Every tie carries a registered role window (`role_valid_from/to`, 211/211 since pass 16) and every contract carries a date, yet no surface computes how much of a tie's money fell inside the role — the ledger, the spis and the claims all print the raw total, and the per-tie `temporal_status` is a four-token summary written once by a batch.

## Description
Corroborated-by: 3 scout(s), theme T5 (World time on the graph: dated edges, role-window alignment, club-at-vote); deck rank #27 of 47; full record docs/architect/moonshot-2026-09-01.md.

`mapLinkedToTie()` reads `roleValidFrom`/`roleValidTo`/`temporalStatus` (`features/money/moneyLoader.ts:223-225`), but the corpus fold deliberately reads `supplies` EDGES only — "NO line items … reading 152 788 [contract nodes] costs 7.8 s" (`moneyLoader.ts:110-116`) — and the contract date lives on the NODE (`kg-money.ts:128`). So on the ledger path no date exists to align against; on the case-file path dates are fetched per company (`CONTRACT_LINES_PER_COMPANY = 400`, `:52`) but only to list top lines (`profileMoney.ts:97-99`), never to sum inside the window. `temporalStatus` (`moneyTypes.ts:150`: current / historical / money-postdates-role / historical-no-money) is a batch-002 verdict on the tie as a whole; it cannot say "31 % of this firm's 2,1 mld. landed while the MP sat on the board". The registry technique states the required output: aligned amount and aligned fraction beside the raw figure, undated money counted and disclosed as a floor, computed in ONE imported window helper — and the repo already has that helper for votes (`voteInRolePeriod`, `statuteRelevance.ts:80-85`), unused for money.

Built: `kg-promote`/`kg-compute` materialize `signedOn` (already read from Registr smluv) onto the `supplies` edge props (prop-merge, never reset — `docs/routes/graph-writers.md` rules) so the corpus fold has dates at zero extra reads; `reachableMoney.ts` exports `alignedReach(tie, lines, window)` using the one `voteInRolePeriod`-style day-truncation helper (moved to a shared `roleWindow.ts` both strety and money import); `ReachableTie` gains `alignedCzk`, `undatedCzk`, `undatedCount`; `MoneyBucket` gains the same; `moneyClaims.ts` mints `dosah-vazby-v-obdobi` as a distinct metric (a different statement, per the two-metrics precedent); the ledger, `/penize/[pspId]`, `/penize/firma/[ico]`, the spis money section and the evidence packet print raw and aligned side by side, with "undated: n contracts, x Kč" as the floor caveat; `reviewSignal` gains the aligned fraction as an input (declared, versioned).

## Flow
- Writer: add `signedOn` (and `direction`-style provenance) to `supplies` edge props in the materialization script under the prop-merge rule; verify on a store copy that no other prop moved (`kg-upsert-replaces-props` memory).
- Shared window helper: extract `voteInRolePeriod` into `features/money/roleWindow.ts`, import from strety and reach; boundary tests on both edge days.
- `reachableMoney.ts`: `alignedReach` + bucket fields; `toReachableTie()` carries them; corpus and slice paths both fold dates from edge props (no node scan).
- Claims + `/zdroj`: new metric, re-derivation from the same fold; aggregate status rule unchanged (verified only when every tie is).
- Surfaces: one `AlignedReach` primitive in `features/shared/components/` (raw · aligned · undated floor); ledger column, both case files, spis, packet.
- Review order: add aligned fraction to `reviewSignal` with the weight published in `TieClassExplainer`/metodika; recompute-replay gate for the stored `review_rank` cache.

## Expected impact
A reader sees "firms tied to X received 2,1 mld. Kč, of which 640 mil. during X's registered role (nejméně; 12 smluv bez data)" — the sentence the conflict claim actually needs. Reviewers get a better lead order (high fraction on modest money). Measured: count of ties where aligned ≠ raw, distribution of aligned fraction across the 211 ties, undated share. Could break: the `review_rank` cache and the packet hash change for affected ties (expected, disclosed).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the money figure next to a person gains the simultaneity dimension the conflict claim depends on
Before: 0 surfaces compute an aligned amount; `temporalStatus` is a 4-token tie verdict (`moneyTypes.ts:150`); corpus fold has no dates (`moneyLoader.ts:110-116`)
After: aligned/raw/undated on every reach figure; MISSING INSTRUMENT: the distribution of aligned fraction over the 211 ties (needs the edge-dated fold to exist)
Method: probe - traced date availability on both read paths and the writer
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract
evidence:
- `features/money/moneyLoader.ts:52, 110-116, 223-225, 396-432` — per-company cap, fold reads edges only, window fields read but unused for money.
- `lib/analysis/kg-money.ts:128` — `signedOn` on the contract node, not the edge.
- `features/money/moneyTypes.ts:150, 603-606` — `temporalStatus` tokens.
- `features/money/collisions/statuteRelevance.ts:80-85` — the only role-window test in the repo, vote-side only.
- `features/profile/profileMoney.ts:82-99` — spis carries `roleValidFrom/To` and top lines but no aligned sum.
- `features/money/reachableMoney.ts:176, 242-278` — reach arithmetic has no time dimension.

title: Derivation stamp for graph views: path-rule ref + whole-graph provenance aggrega
body:
## Summary
A graph citation's content hash is compared, but its AUTHOR is not: the path rule (`EXCLUDED_RELS`, `HUB_DEGREE`, `MAX_COST`) and the graph pass that wrote the edges are outside the hash and outside the address, so a rule change that happens to yield the same path is stamped `verified`. `/graf` also publishes no provenance for the graph as a population — the leaderboard already solves exactly this for one relation.

## Description
Corroborated-by: 3 scout(s), theme T4 (Structured, sealed provenance per graph pass with a certified release); deck rank #28 of 47; full record docs/architect/moonshot-2026-09-01.md.

`hashViewContent` hashes `content` only (`getPermalinkData.ts` `resolveView`: `{kind:"cesta", from, to, path}`; `maxCost`/`hubDegree` live in `core`, not `content`), and the constants are literals in `trailPath.ts:191-200` with no version identity. Change `HUB_DEGREE` 120 → 90 and a two-hop path that survives re-derives byte-identical → `fresh: true` → `/overeni` says `verified` (`verdict.ts:198`), the exact "coincidence stamped verified" the technique names. Node views carry `provenance.pass/ref` for the ONE node (`graphLoader.ts:874-879`); path and trail views carry no pass at all, and the seed shows only counts (`GraphPage.tsx:109-113`). The repo already has the population aggregate for `contribution_provenance` — `summarizeContributionProvenance` with `uniform | mixed | absent` + variants (`features/civicscore/provenance.ts:23-60, 95`) — and a sentinel check `provenance-uniformity` + `formula-ref` (`lib/testing/sentinel/invariants.ts:374, 399`); none of it covers `kg_edge.provenance`. The tender pass (68) landed on a store still carrying earlier passes for other relations, so the graph is by construction `mixed` per relation — which is fine to publish as a variant table and wrong to publish as one number.

Built: `PATH_RULE_REF = "evidence-path/v1"` exported from `trailPath.ts` beside the constants (bumped on any semantic change, test-pinned); `summarizeGraphProvenance(edges)` (pure, reusing the civicscore aggregate's shape) grouped by `rel` → `{pass, ref, method}` variants with coverage `stamped/read`; `content` for `cesta` gains `{ruleRef, excludedRels, hubDegree, maxCost}` and every view gains `graphProvenance` (uniform → one `{pass,ref}`; mixed → per-rel variant table; absent → no field). `/overeni` compares the cited `ruleRef` to today's and returns `moved` with the "same path, different rule" sentence. `/graf` header and `/dashboard` state slice print the per-relation variant table; the sentinel gets `graph-provenance-uniformity` (mixed across rels is informational; mixed WITHIN one rel is the alarm) and `path-rule-ref` (store's stamped rule vs code's constant).

## Flow
- `trailPath.ts`: export `PATH_RULE_REF` and a `pathRule()` object; `trailPath.test.ts` pins the ref against the constants (changing one without the other fails).
- `lib/kg/graphProvenance.ts` (pure): `summarizeGraphProvenance(edges: {rel, provenance}[])` → per-rel `{state, pass, ref, method, computedAt, variants, coverage}`; fixtures for uniform / mixed-within-rel / absent.
- `graphLoader.ts`: `buildIndex` computes the aggregate once (it already scans all edges at `:171-175`); `GraphSeed`, `Trail`, `PathQueryResult` carry it; `resolveView` puts `ruleRef` + the aggregate (only when uniform per rel, per the technique's "no single author → no derivation field") into `content`.
- `permalink.ts`: `toEvidenceJsonLd` adds `path_rule_ref`, `graph_provenance_state`, per-rel `provenance_pass`; `permalinkCardModel` adds `basisChanged`.
- `/overeni`: `hashedVerdict` gains `basis: {cited, current}`; verdict copy for moved-by-basis; the `g.` decoder tolerates absent basis (older refs: "stamps not compared", never a mismatch).
- `GraphPage` header SourceNote and `/dashboard` state-graph slice print the variant table (SourceNote citing `kg_edge.provenance`).
- `invariants.ts`: two new checks, "unevaluable" when the store is unreachable.

## Expected impact
Editors and the gate can tell "same number, different formula" from "verified"; operators see a half-recomputed relation as a red check instead of a confident pass number. Measured by: sentinel output before (no graph checks) vs after (two checks, with the live per-rel variant table); count of `moved-by-basis` verdicts after the next `HUB_DEGREE`/`EXCLUDED_RELS` change (today undetectable). Could break: adding `ruleRef` to `content` moves every existing `cesta` ref once (a deliberate, announced basis bump — the alternative is hashing a lie).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - derivation identity becomes carried and compared for every graph citation and for the graph as a population
Before: `trailPath.ts:191-200` constants unversioned; `resolveView` content for `cesta` = `{from,to,path}`; `verdict.ts:198` verified on hash equality alone; `invariants.ts` has `formula-ref`/`provenance-uniformity` for persons only; graph-level pass distribution unpublished
After: the MISSING INSTRUMENT is the per-rel aggregate itself — `select rel, provenance->>'pass', provenance->>'ref', count(*) from kg_edge group by 1,2,3` over the live store (not run: store closed to this scout)
Method: probe - traced hash inputs and gate comparison; reasoning on a constant change
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract - JSON-LD fields and the one-time basis bump of issued refs
evidence:
- `features/graph/trailPath.ts:191-200` — `EXCLUDED_RELS`, `HUB_DEGREE = 120`, `MAX_COST = 6`, no ref
- `features/graph/getPermalinkData.ts` `resolveView` — `content: { kind: "cesta", from, to, path }`; `core` carries `maxCost/hubDegree` outside the hash
- `features/overeni/verdict.ts:190-198` — verdict from `fresh` only
- `features/civicscore/provenance.ts:23-60, 95, 142` — the aggregate to reuse; `lib/testing/sentinel/invariants.ts:374, 399` — person-only checks
- `features/graph/graphLoader.ts:171-175` — full edge scan already in `buildIndex`; `:874-879` — single-node provenance only

title: Club affiliation dated at the ballot: membership windows in the record
body:
## Summary
Every club line, rebellion rate and cohesion index in the group is computed against ONE club per mandate for the whole term, picked by row order from an undated join — an MP who changed club has every historical ballot repainted, and which club wins is decided by the dump.

## Description
Corroborated-by: 3 scout(s), theme T5 (World time on the graph: dated edges, role-window alignment, club-at-vote); deck rank #29 of 47; full record docs/architect/moonshot-2026-09-01.md.

`lib/db/pglite/repositories/graph.ts:141-159` (`clubByMandate`) joins `membership` on `person_psp_id` and `kind = 'member'` to the term's `Klub` organs with no predicate on `from_at`/`to_at`, then `out.set(mandate, abbrev)` per row — a person with two club rows yields whichever row the query returned last. `MembershipRow` carries `fromAt`/`toAt` (`lib/db/types.ts:77-78`), so the windows exist and are ignored. Every consumer takes that single map: `record/derive.ts:250` (`clubByMandate.get(b.mandatePspId)` per ballot, regardless of `votedOn`), `lib/analysis/kg.ts:175-190` (`rebellion()` → the `rebels_against` edges and `rebellion_rate` prop on 207 persons), `partyCohesion()` (`kg.ts:257+`), `scripts/data-analysis/kg-compute.ts:107`, `getKompas.ts:147` (the MP's club on the result board), and through `rebellion_rate` the Nezávislost pillar. This is exactly the „current-party column" failure the modeling subject names, and the same dump-order defect `/zakony` fixed for committee dates on 2026-08-13 (`docs/routes/zakony.md`: „the committee date stopped being decided by dump ROW ORDER"). The repo already treats the open-ended membership as the current-holder signal (`memory/current-mandate-holder-signal.md`), so the windows are trusted elsewhere.

Built: `clubWindowsByMandate(term)` returns `Map<mandate, {club, fromAt, toAt}[]>`; a pure `clubAt(windows, mandate, isoDay)` picks the window containing the vote day (open `toAt` = current). `deriveVoteRecord` and `rebellion()` take the windows and the vote date; a ballot cast on a day inside no club window is a new bucket `outsideClubWindow` (counted in `coverage`, never folded into `unaffiliated`, never scored). Club aggregates split by era only where an MP's club changed; the profile's rebellion chronicle names the club AT the vote. The kompas board prints club-at-vote per question and current club per MP, with copy saying which is which. `kg-compute` recompute goes through the replay gate (`memory/recompute-replay-gate.md`): the old formula must reproduce every stored `rebellion_rate` first, then the windowed formula writes with a new pass.

## Flow
- Probe on a store copy: persons with >1 `Klub` membership row in PSP10; ballots whose `votedOn` falls outside the window of the club `clubByMandate` currently assigns them; the number of MPs whose `rebellion_rate` moves.
- `store.clubWindowsByMandate(term)` beside the old method; `lib/analysis/clubAt.ts` pure + tests (window edges, open end, no window, two windows on one day = refuse + count).
- `derive.ts`: thread `votedOn` into pass 1 and pass 2; add `coverage.outsideClubWindow`; `derive.test.ts` fixture with a mid-term switch.
- `kg.ts` `rebellion()`/`partyCohesion()` + `kg-compute.ts` under the replay gate; `graph-schema.md` notes the basis change on `rebels_against` and `party.cohesion`.
- Surfaces: chronicle row + rebel board print the club at the vote; the profile and kompas copy distinguish „klub při hlasování" from „klub dnes".
- Retire `clubByMandate` once no consumer remains; `docs/routes/hlasovani.md` dated entry with the measured delta.

## Expected impact
Named MPs who switched club stop being scored as rebels against a club they were not in (or shielded by one they were). Measured by the count of persons whose eligible/rebel counts change and by `coverage.outsideClubWindow`. What could break: published rebellion rates move for a handful of named people — the change must ship with its before/after table and the replay-gate proof, or it reads as an unattributable rewrite.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every club-relative figure is computed against the club the MP was in on the day of the vote
Before: `clubByMandate` SQL has zero date predicates and last-row-wins semantics (graph.ts:141-159); 100 % of ballots are scored against a term-wide club
After: MISSING INSTRUMENT — count of PSP10 persons with >1 club window and count of ballots whose day is outside the assigned club's window; today not runnable here without the store
Method: probe - read the SQL, the membership shape, and all five consumers of the map
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: policy
evidence:
- `lib/db/pglite/repositories/graph.ts:141-159` — join on `ms.person_psp_id … and ms.kind = 'member'`, no `from_at`/`to_at`; `out.set(...)` per row
- `lib/db/types.ts:69-82` — `MembershipRow.fromAt/toAt` exist
- `features/votetrack/record/derive.ts:250,299` — `clubByMandate.get(b.mandatePspId)` without a date
- `lib/analysis/kg.ts:175-190` — `rebellion(… mandateToClub …)`; `scripts/data-analysis/kg-compute.ts:107`
- `features/votetrack/getKompas.ts:147` — `clubByMandate.get(b.mandatePspId) ?? null`
- `docs/routes/zakony.md` 2026-08-13 — the dump-row-order precedent this repeats
